meta_title: Crypto Payments API for Developers | Dynopay
meta_description: Integrate Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and 15+ chains with one REST API. Non-custodial, webhooks, SDKs, and sandbox included. Start building in minutes.
h1: Crypto Payments API: Accept BTC, ETH, SOL, and 15+ chains
subheading: One REST API to integrate non-custodial crypto payments. No smart contracts to write, no custody headaches—funds go directly to your wallet.
intro_paragraph: Most crypto payment integrations force you to write and audit smart contracts, manage multiple chain connections, or trust a third party with custody. Dynopay gives you a single REST API covering Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, Tron, XRP Ledger, and more—with webhooks, official SDKs, and a sandbox for testing. Your customers pay in crypto, and funds arrive directly in your wallet. You stay non-custodial, and your integration stays simple.

features.title: One API, 15+ chains
features.description: Support Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, USDC, Solana, XRP, and more without managing separate nodes or writing contracts. Add new chains as Dynopay ships them—no code changes required on your end.

features.title: Non-custodial by design
features.description: Payments settle directly to your wallet address. Dynopay never holds, freezes, or controls your funds. You own the keys, you own the money—no withdrawal delays or account limits.

features.title: Webhooks and sandbox environment
features.description: Listen for payment confirmations, refunds, and status changes via webhooks. Test every integration scenario with sandbox mode and test API keys before you go live.

how_it_works: Sign up, verify your email, and add your payout wallet address—takes under five minutes.
Grab your API key from the dashboard and call the payments endpoint to create a charge.
Listen for webhook events when payments confirm, then fulfill the order or unlock content programmatically.

faqs.question: Which cryptocurrencies does the Dynopay API support?
faqs.answer: Bitcoin, Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash, Dogecoin, Ethereum (plus USDT, USDC, and RLUSD on ERC-20), Polygon (MATIC and USDT), Tron (TRX and USDT-TRC20), Solana, and XRP Ledger (XRP and RLUSD). All chains accessible through one API endpoint.

faqs.question: Do I need to write smart contracts to accept payments?
faqs.answer: No. Dynopay monitors on-chain transactions for you. You create a charge via API, display the payment address to your user, and receive a webhook when funds confirm. No Solidity, no audits, no gas optimization required.

faqs.question: What are the API fees and transaction costs?
faqs.answer: Dynopay charges 1.5% per successful transaction plus a small fixed fee: one dollar for orders under one hundred dollars, scaling to one dollar for orders under one thousand. No monthly fees, no setup costs, no hidden charges.

faqs.question: How long does API integration take?
faqs.answer: Most developers create a test charge in under ten minutes. The REST API uses standard JSON, webhooks follow a predictable schema, and official SDKs are available for Node.js, Python, and PHP. Sandbox mode lets you test end-to-end before going live.

faqs.question: Do you hold funds or require KYC for API users?
faqs.answer: Dynopay is non-custodial—payments go directly to the wallet address you specify. No KYC is required to receive crypto. KYC applies only if you choose to use a fiat off-ramp in certain jurisdictions, which is optional.

cta_headline: Start building with the Dynopay API
cta_body: Generate your API keys and create a test charge in under ten minutes. No monthly fees, no custody, no contracts to write.
